module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons installs Helm/Kubernetes add-ons but is only ordered against the EKS control-plane outputs. It does not wait for the managed node group to be ready, so Helm releases with wait=true can be created before any worker nodes exist and time out. It should depend on the managed node group (or otherwise wait for worker capacity).
